prompt:
Create one realistic desktop app UI mockup at 1440 x 1024 as the final visual target for a local interactive HTML prototype. The attached v5 is the structure to preserve. The user explicitly requests a slightly more inventive technical color system while keeping the calm Apple-inspired modules and icon-led minimalism.

Use a mineral-white canvas #EDF2F2, white frosted surfaces #F8FBFA at 88% opacity, deep petrol #183B40 for readable ink and the primary button, secondary text #607276, ice-cyan #D8EDF0 only for selection. Accent #0B6875. No purple, neon, colored blobs, scenic backgrounds, glowing borders, promotional titles or dashboard metrics.
System sans-serif, 16px/500 filenames, 16px/400 body with line height 1.6, 14px metadata. 1088px centered content width, equal toolbar and card edges. Module radius16px, controls12px, 44px hit areas, 24px internal padding,12px gaps. Short soft shadows and subtle real-looking frosted depth, never plastic or heavy blur. Use familiar consistent Phosphor Regular-style icons, about20px; do not label obvious controls.

First batch metadata: small tray-up icon then "Nov 5, 2026 · 1:00 AM".

"Design critique", small secondary "design-critique.wav · Sample", duration "00:42", check-circle at right and collapse caret.

"The upload time should stay with the batch,"
"so each recording is easy to find."
"00:07" speaker "Daniel" with caret, text:

"Research interview", small secondary "research-interview.wav · Sample", "00:39", check-circle and right caret.

"Product planning", small secondary "product-planning.wav · Sample", "00:45", check-circle and right caret.
The actual HTML prototype will contain real synthetic speech audio, exact measured times, click-to-seek transcripts, editable speakers, notes and sample-grounded Q&A in its detail page.
